about: versioned correction table: each Smart-Bone action, its driver bone and angle range, and what it sculpts

actions.effect: shoulder bulge on the turning side (+0.045 m radius at the neck base, pushed 0.05 m toward the turn), neck shortened 12% so the jaw clears the shoulder, a skin fold stroke at the neck base, ears swing back 30% (they lead the turn)

actions.driver: spine bone curl = crouch (0..1, 0.5 == 18 deg of hunch)
actions.effect: waist point raised 0.035 m (arched back), belly tucked (waist radius -0.018 m), rump dropped 0.03 m, tail tucks

actions.driver: stifle angle (deg between femur and tibia)
actions.effect: haunch mass grows (+0.035 m thigh radius at the hip, +0.03 m at mid thigh) and moves 0.03 m forward; hip point lowered so the folded thigh reads round, not as a stick

actions.driver: elbow angle (deg between humerus and radius)
actions.effect: elbow nub (0.032 m) appears behind the joint; chest point drops 0.06 m and shrinks 0.025 m so the chest lies on the floor between the forearms
nape crest raised 0.02 m and neck base thickened 0.015 m so the line of the back flows into the lowered head; a throat fold stroke

actions.driver: rest (chin on paws, 0..1) through head pitch
actions.effect: chin pushed back 0.01 m and the jowl flattened onto the paw; eye lid half closed
